description: This file contains shell functions for upgrading firmware on specific hardware platforms within the OpenWrt project. It defines the platform check and upgrade procedures based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is valid for upgrade. Currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, selecting the appropriate method based on the board name.
